about.titleEnd: oo u Dhexeeya Waxbarashada iyo Fursadda
about.intro: FursadHub waxay isku xidhaa ardayda, ururrada iyo jaamacadaha iyadoo adeegsanaysa habab tababar oo dhab ah oo taageera waxbarashada iyo horumarinta shaqada.

mission.title: Himiladeenna
mission.body: Ku xidh ardayda fursado dhab ah, ururrada hibo soo koraysa, jaamacadahana natiijooyin tababar oo cad.

vision.title: Aragtideenna
vision.body: Bulsho tababar oo la isku halayn karo halkaas oo waxbarashada iyo waayo-aragnimada shaqadu wada shaqeeyaan.

reasons.students: Ardaydu waxay u baahan yihiin fursado tababar oo khuseeya.
reasons.organizations: Ururradu waxay u baahan yihiin hibo cusub oo karti leh.
reasons.universities: Jaamacaduhu waxay u baahan yihiin kormeer tababar oo habaysan.
reasons.platform: FursadHub waxay hababkan ku xidhaa hal madal.

about.countsHint: Tirooyin toos ah oo ka yimid tusmooyinka dadweynaha. Waxba halkan qiyaas ma aha.
about.journeyHint: Hal marin oo laga bilaabo daabacaadda ilaa dhammaystirka. Codsiyada dadweynaha iyo magacaabista jaamacadaha waxay ku wada biiraan isla liiska musharraxiinta.

sourcing.title: Raadinta
sourcing.body: Hay'addu waxay tababar u daabacdaa dadweynaha, ama waxay si gaar ah ugu tilmaantaa jaamacado iyo waaxyo, ama labadaba isku mar.

candidacy.title: Hal marin musharrax
candidacy.body: Ardaygu si toos ah ayuu u codsadaa, ama isuduwaha waaxdu wuu magacaabaa isagoo raalli ka ah. Labada marinba waxay dhaliyaan hal musharrax oo keliya arday iyo tababar kasta.

offer.title: Dalab iyo meelayn
offer.body: Shaqaalaysiintu waxay ku socotaa tallaabooyin cad. Marka ardaygu dalabka aqbalo, meelaynta waxaa la abuuraa isla wakhtigaas.

supervision.title: Kormeerid
supervision.body: Diiwaanka toddobaadlaha, xaadirinta, iyo kormeerayaasha jaamacadda iyo hay'adda, sida ay siyaasadda jaamacaddu dhigto.

completion.title: Qiimayn iyo dhammaystir
completion.body: Qiimayn, warbixin ugu dambaysa iyo difaac marka siyaasaddu u baahan tahay, iyo diiwaan dhammaystir oo ku xiran macnaha waxbarasho ee saxda ah.

students.title: Ardayda
students.body: Fiiri oo codso marka jaamacaddaadu xaqiijiso diiwaangelintaada, ka dibna hal meel ku maamul meelayntaada, diiwaannadaada iyo warbixinnadaada.

organizations.title: Hay'adaha
organizations.body: Daabac tababarro, ka codso magacaabis jaamacadaha aad la shaqaynaysid, eeg hal liis musharraxiin, oo kormeer tababarlayaasha aad qaadato.

universities.title: Jaamacadaha
universities.body: Xaqiiji ardaydaada, u magacaab tababarrada la beegsaday, dhig siyaasadda tababarka, oo kormeer meelaynta ilaa dhammaystir.

about.trustHint: Si cad ayaa loo sheegayaa, maxaa yeelay kalsooni waa fudud tahay in la ilaaliyo marka loo eego dib u dhis.

trust.biometrics: Ma jiro aqoonsi waji, hubin biometric ah ama xaadirin biometric ah.
trust.evidence: Caddaymaha xaqiijinta iyo dukumiintiyada gaarka ah waligood dadweyne ma noqdaan, soo dejin kastana waa la oggolaadaa waana la diiwaangeliyaa.
trust.testimonials: Kaliya markhaatiyada ay qoreen isticmaalayaal dhab ah oo uu daabacay maamule ayaa bogga ka muuqda.
trust.pilot: Tijaabadu waa bilaash. Ma jiro wax lacag bixin ah oo alaabta ku jira.

about.ctaBody: Samayso akoon arday, hay'ad ama jaamacad ahaan.

placement.body: Diiwaanka usbuucyada, imaanshaha, kormeerka iyo qiimeynta ayaa tababarka geeya ilaa difaaciisa.

landing.trustLine: Loogu talagalay jaamacadaha, ururrada iyo ardayda Soomaaliya.

lifecycle.title: Hal socod, laga bilaabo ilaa dhammaystirka
lifecycle.body: Meel dhigiddu kuma dhamaato dalabka shaqada oo keliya. FursadHub wuxuu socodsiiyaa diiwaanka usbuucyada, imaanshaha, kormeerka labada dhinac, qiimeynta iyo difaaca ugu dambeeya — si jaamacadaha iyo ururradu u arkaan horumar dhab ah.
